title: Soul Feast #75: Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences – Angels
excerpt: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world.
bodyHtml:
Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world. Start your journey to multisensory perception HERE 

In this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav reveals something more fundamental than non-physical teachers: non-physical communication never stops. From a physics meeting at Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory to a first night at Esalen that could not have been random, 

Gary traces the invisible guidance that shaped his awakening long before the personality had words for it. 

As a young man hungry for meaning in the Earth School, he met the physicist who became his mentor and watched the chapters of The Dancing Wu Li Masters write and arrange themselves without outlines – until he could no longer pretend he was creating alone.

The through line is unmistakable: non-physical communication speaks through passion, through sudden knowing, through the chapters of a life that arrange themselves—and through the laughter of a grandmother who lingered at her own funeral to delight in her own transition.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (00:00) — Beyond the Teacher: Why non-physical communication is far broader than channeling – and how Gary reframes it as the constant language of the Soul, available to every multisensory human.
  • (03:07) — A Soul Returns Home: Gary reflects on the Soul’s transition of Linda Francis and reframes death not as catastrophe but as a soul returning home, welcomed by non-physical teachers and fellow souls into a loving embrace.
  • (06:07) — The Spark at Lawrence Berkeley: How a Friday afternoon gathering of renowned physicists ignited something Gary couldn’t yet articulate – and why that uncontainable excitement was itself a form of non-physical communication.
  • (08:47) — One Night at Esalen: The story of how Gary met Al Wong and David Finkelstein on his very first evening at Esalen – encounters that gave birth to The Dancing Wu Li Masters and, Gary says, could not possibly have been random.
  • (15:10) — The Chapters That Closed Themselves: The pivotal moment during the writing of The Dancing Wu Li Masters when Gary realized he was not creating alone – and understood for the first time that it is not possible to create alone.
  • (18:02) — Grandmother Libby’s Laugh: A tender early memory of non-physical communication – when Gary felt his grandmother’s presence at her own funeral, delighting in her own transition and jerking his hand as she always had in life.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Think of a moment that arrived too perfectly to be coincidence – a meeting, a passion, a knowing deeper than thought. What if that wasn’t luck? Where has non-physical communication already been at work in your story – and what might it be saying to you right now?
